content:
It looks like President Trump is quite fond of Chinese President Xi Jinping, and a montage that aired on Stephen Colbert's "The Late Show" on Tuesday made that abundantly clear.

Colbert noted: "Trump didn't care about the subject or the meeting details. He just wanted to buddy up with Xi. He made it clear he'd been looking forward to reuniting with Xi for a long, long time."

Colbert then played a series of clips in which Trump referred to Xi as a "remarkable person" and a "great gentleman." In several of the clips, Trump could be heard praising Xi's physical attributes, noting his "extraordinary presence" and "extraordinary aura."

Commenting on Trump's flattery, Colbert quipped: "You sound like a Long Island mom trying to set up her grown daughter on a date."

Colbert then aired footage showing service members at Joint Base Andrews on Wednesday hand-rolling a red carpet onto the tarmac as Trump welcomed Xi.

Trump continued his effusive praise of Xi as the Chinese leader visited the White House for a grand state dinner.

"Since I was first elected in 2016, President Xi and I have built a friendship — a truly great friendship — based on mutual respect and the significant interests of the peoples of our two countries," Trump said.
